summary: All requirements are properly implemented. The WorkflowSection component has been removed from App.tsx and replaced with ReferralProgramSection. The new component displays the referral program information in Spanish with proper commission structure details (15-30% commission, 15% of net value, payment after client payment, 30-day transfer), uses a card-based layout with appropriate icons (Handshake, TrendingUp, Clock, DollarSign), and maintains design consistency with the cybersecurity theme.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a 'Cómo Funciona' (How It Works) section with a 3-step process explanation for the referral program
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not specify adding a process explanation section below the commission details. REQ-15 only required commission structure information, and REQ-16 only required highlighting commission details prominently with icons.
